integrity: All embedded proofs, reported computations, and source comparisons are recorded without independent certification; complete reproduction uses the supplied source.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for iid exactly uniform draws with replacement. Its first-public-date anchor is the 2010 arXiv release of the main modern reference, not a claim of priority for classical coupon or birthday methods. A relevant 2008 article was available in abstract only and possible implicit coverage by earlier joint enumeration is a historical-priority risk. Finite tests do not establish the infinite theorem; the manuscript proof does.
title: Negative regression and residual dependence between birthday and cover times
